title: MERIDIAN Longform Article
description: Schema for the Research & Analysis tab's reading material -- scholarly/policy/journalism pieces from outlets like The Economist, Foreign Affairs, Foreign Policy, NYT, WSJ. Deliberately separate from normalized_event.schema.json: these are commentary/analysis pieces meant to be read, not discrete dated events/actions, so they don't belong on the Unified Intelligence Map or in the event-scored News & Social Signal tab. Only ever populated from each outlet's own free, publicly-published RSS feed (headline + teaser + link) -- never from an authenticated scrape of paywalled full-text content.

article_id.description: Deterministic hash of source + link, used to dedupe across re-runs.

teaser.description: Short description/subhead/dek as published in the feed -- not the full article body.

link.description: URL to the full article on the publisher's own site.

image_url.description: Thumbnail image URL pulled from the feed's media:content/enclosure tag, if present.

published_date.description: ISO 8601 date the article was published.
